notes: Attaches to a native <button type="button">: `selector: 'button[dsButton]'`. A consumer writes <button dsButton hierarchy="primary">.

The `hierarchy` axis is spelled `hierarchy`, not `role`, for the reason the React binding gives — `role` is a real HTML attribute and a button carrying role="primary" would stop being announced as a button. That reason is about HTML, so all three backends reach it independently.

`loading` is `control: consumer` and the contract says it must reach assistive technology as well as the eye. Nothing in the contract says HOW; `aria-busy` is the conventional answer and no emitter can know that.
